subtopics.content: 5-minute speed and accuracy test at 40 words per minute (syllabic intensity 1.35–1.40)
subtopics.objective: Demonstrate typing speed and accuracy at a minimum of 40 words per minute with correct technique and minimal errors.

subtopics.content: Pre-printed A4/A5 headed paper, letters and memoranda with insets/continuation sheets/subject headings/enclosures/copy distributions, form/circular letters, envelope addressing, manuscripts with/without inset matter, headings (main, sub, shoulder, paragraph, marginal), paragraphing (blocked, indented, hanging), numbering formats, and display materials (menus, advertisements, itineraries)
subtopics.objective: Format business correspondence including letters, memos, circulars, and envelopes accurately; transcribe handwritten manuscripts with correction signs; apply appropriate paragraphing, numbering styles, and display layouts for menus, advertisements, and itineraries.

topics.title: Meetings, Business Forms, Tabulation, Literary, and Financial Statements

subtopics.content: Notices of meetings, agendas, minutes, reports, completion of pre-printed business forms (applications, invoices, order forms, delivery/advice notes, cards), tabulations with/without ruling or leader dots, literary works (plays, poems, articles, footnotes), and simple financial statements of account
subtopics.objective: Produce documents for meetings including notices, agendas, and minutes; complete pre-printed business forms and cards; construct ruled or unruled numerical and alphabetical tabulations; type literary works with footnotes and simple financial statements.
